key_idea: Fix the left end l (prefix before it must stay non-negative), extend r while the running balance of the flipped segment stays non-negative, and test the untouched suffix in O(1) with precomputed suffix sum and suffix minimum-prefix.
sketch: Precompute for every suffix its total T[i] and its minimum prefix balance M[i]. Odd length is impossible; an already valid string is possible. For each l with a non-negative prefix balance, walk r from l accumulating the inverted brackets; break as soon as the balance goes negative (larger r cannot help); the suffix after r is fine iff b+T[r+1]==0 and b+M[r+1]>=0. O(n^2) = 25M simple steps for n=5000. Pitfalls: 'at most one' includes zero operations; stop the outer loop when the unflipped prefix goes negative. Stress-tested against an exhaustive brute force.
